verdicts.reason: A: the headline is huge and clearly the focus, but 'the limit' runs into the bottom of the striped building photo, so text sits on a busy image. 'not' is left alone on its own line, and the photo is still a small strip cut off at the left edge instead of being rescaled. B: no collisions, but it is basically the banner pasted into the top half. The headline and the small photo strip float in the upper 60%, the bottom ~40% of the canvas is dead white space, and the photo strip is cramped against the left edge, so the layout is lopsided and doesn't suit a square. A at least fills the format with intent.
